evidence_type: Pinned AOSP source inspection, not testing of the owner's Android phone

findings.quality_setting_layer: Phone-side Bluetooth A2DP codec configuration; not H1 SPP/RCSP noise control
findings.settings_default: BluetoothQualityDialogPreference.getDefaultIndex() returns 3, corresponding to the best-effort radio option
findings.quality_mapping: BluetoothQualityDialogPreferenceController writes codecSpecific1 = 1000 + selected index for indices 0 through 3
findings.settings_setter: AbstractBluetoothDialogPreferenceController calls BluetoothA2dp.setCodecConfigPreference for the active A2DP device
findings.public_sdk_boundary: BluetoothA2dp.getCodecStatus and setCodecConfigPreference are @hide / @SystemApi, not unrestricted ordinary public SDK APIs
findings.permission_boundary: Inspected framework docs require BLUETOOTH_CONNECT plus BLUETOOTH_PRIVILEGED or a Companion Device Manager association. The A2dpService binder applies enforceCdmAssociationIfNotBluetoothPrivileged to both methods
findings.companion_route_limit: A service permission exception does not make the method a stable public SDK API or establish access on every Android/OEM build. A matching package/UID/device association can authorize the setter without granting BLUETOOTH_PRIVILEGED; owner-phone access and reconfiguration remain separate tests
findings.hidden_api_runtime_policy: Official Android 16 hidden-API flags classify both exact A2DP getter/setter descriptors as sdk,system-api,test-api, not public-api. They are not blanket-blocked entries; @hide/@SystemApi alone is not proof that ordinary reflection requires root or a restrictions bypass
findings.version_qualification: The original five retained files describe one current source snapshot. Additional source review found different Binder gates across Android 12-16, including Android 15 r36's privileged-only getter while its setter still accepts a CDM association. Android major version alone is insufficient for compatibility claims
findings.persistence: No owner-phone reconnect/restart persistence or automatic reapplication was tested
findings.quality_not_throughput: A configured quality policy is not a measurement of instantaneous encoded bitrate or radio throughput

access_review_addendum.evidence_type: Read-only AOSP/document review, not commercial-app implementation or owner-phone runtime evidence
access_review_addendum.association_checks: Utils checks the Binder calling UID against the supplied package in that Android user's context, then requires the same package and requested device MAC, case-insensitively. Self-managed associations and null addresses do not qualify. A Bluetooth bond alone is insufficient

version_snapshots.additional_getter_gate_beyond_bluetooth_: BLUETOOTH_PRIVILEGED; no CDM exception in this getter snapshot

access_review_addendum.compatibility_limit: These are inspected source tags and official flag files, not a guarantee about any OEM/Mainline build, work profile, or the commercial app's actual method path

retention: The original five unmodified decoded AOSP source files and their hash manifest remain retained in the approved local temporary directory; none was compiled or installed. Addendum URLs and exact selected flag entries are recorded separately and are not counted as additional retained source files
limitations: Current AOSP source is not proof of the code, default, permissions or persistence in the owner's particular Android/OEM build.
No Android device was queried, associated, rooted, configured or re-paired during this follow-up.
No quality-setting command, hidden-API experiment, Shizuku operation or automatic reapplication was executed.
A GitHub tree lookup for additional pinned H1 app files returned HTTP 403; this supplement does not claim to inspect every Android codec helper.
